site.whatsappMessage: Hi Mutnani Group, I'd like to talk about a prefab / roofing requirement.

hero.sub: Three companies under one group: pre-engineered structures, our own PUF panel line, and the import desk that sources what neither can make. Fabrication runs in parallel with your foundation, so the shed is closed in weeks rather than seasons.

about.title: We are an authorised dealer of Hyderabad Industries Ltd.
body: Balaji Agencies was established in 2000 by M. Madhu Sudhan. Since its inception it has handled corporate projects across Andhra Pradesh and other parts of India.

The group has had the opportunity to work with well-established names in Indian infrastructure — Navyug Engineering Company Ltd, Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd and the NTPC power plant among them.

group.title: Three companies, one schedule
group.lede: Each company could run on its own. Together they cover the design, the panels and the shipping.

divisions.lede: We design the building, make it in our shop, and put it up on your site.
divisions.imageAlt: A long pre-engineered steel building under construction: bare portal frames and purlins with a mobile crane alongside.

divisions.lede: We make the PUF panels and roofing sheets ourselves, in our own factory.
divisions.imageAlt: Stacked white insulated PUF panels on roller conveyors inside a panel manufacturing hall.

divisions.lede: We buy what the other two do not make, and ship what they do.
divisions.imageAlt: A container ship loaded with stacked shipping containers at sea.

build.title: Six steps, two at the same time
build.lede: Your slab cures on site while our shop fabricates the structure.

steps.title: Drawing & approval
steps.body: Structural drawings against your layout and load case. Nothing is cut until you have signed the fabrication drawing.
steps.imageAlt: Steel fabrication drawings of a portal-frame building spread across an engineer’s desk.

steps.title: Foundation on site
steps.body: Your civil team casts the pedestals and anchor bolts to our template while the steel is being fabricated.
steps.imageAlt: Concrete pedestal footings with protruding anchor bolts, set out in a row across a cleared site.

steps.title: Fabrication in shop
steps.body: Columns, rafters, purlins and panels cut, welded, drilled and painted under cover — no weather, no site wastage.
steps.imageAlt: Steel sections being welded and prepared inside a fabrication workshop.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Sequenced to the erection order, so the crane lifts what it needs next instead of shifting stacks around the yard.
steps.imageAlt: A flatbed trailer loaded with bundled steel sections arriving at site.

steps.title: Erection
steps.body: Bolted, not welded, on site. Columns plumbed, rafters landed, purlins run, then panels and sheeting close the envelope.
steps.imageAlt: A crane lifting a steel rafter into place on a partly erected frame.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Gutters, ridge, flashings, doors and ventilators. You get as-built drawings and the panel specification on paper.
steps.imageAlt: The completed clad building with gutters and ridge finished.

prefab.title: Balaji Prefab Solutions
prefab.sub: We draw it, make it, erect it

capabilities.name: Pre-engineered buildings
capabilities.body: Clear spans to 42 m with no internal column, designed to the load your state code asks for.

capabilities.name: Industrial sheds & workshops
capabilities.body: Crane gantries, mezzanines and service penetrations set in the drawing, not cut on site.

capabilities.name: Warehouses & godowns
capabilities.body: Long bays, dock heights and roof pitch worked back from how the shed will actually be loaded.

capabilities.name: Turnkey execution
capabilities.body: Foundations, structure, cladding and handover on one contract, against one programme.

prefab.note: Structural drawings are ours and stay yours — issued at handover, not held to force a return visit.
prefab.imageAlt: A steel portal frame going up at dusk, a crane setting the last rafter under the site lights.

products.title: Everything the three divisions make
products.lede: If it is on this list, it is drawn, fabricated or sourced by one of the three companies — not sub-let to a contractor you never meet.

projects.title: Where the group's steel is standing
projects.lede: Executed with and for the infrastructure companies below across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and beyond. Areas and durations are the group's own records — confirm the ones you want to quote.

partners.title: Trusted by industry leaders
partners.lede: Executed with and for infrastructure companies across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and beyond — site buildings, sheds, panels and stores.

videos.title: Watch it go up
videos.lede: Straight from the group’s own sites — frames landing, panels going on, sheds closing in. Shot by the crews, not a production house.

trust.eyebrow: Why the group gets asked back
trust.title: Twenty-six years, and the same phone number

points.title: Founded 2000
points.body: Started by M. Madhu Sudhan as an authorised dealer of Hyderabad Industries Ltd., and still run by the same family.

points.title: We make what we fit
points.body: The PUF panels on your wall came off our own line. There is no supplier in the middle to blame for a slipped date.

points.title: One team, drawing to handover
points.body: Design, fabrication, transport and erection sit inside the group. You sign one contract and call one number.

points.title: Two offices, one schedule
points.body: Hyderabad runs execution, Mumbai runs the trade desk. A project in either region is somebody's day job, not a trip.
